notes: Fly fishing is a defined repeatable task loop - walk the bank, pick a pool, cast, fight the fish - which is Role Sim rather than Roleplay's open-ended storytelling, and there is no shop, gate or rebirth in the prompt to make it an Incremental Simulator. I swapped the preset's world-open for space-bounded because the answers ask for a short walkable stretch with a few pools kept small and focused rather than a world to roam, and dropped path-road-vehicle since nothing is driven; trigger-task becomes the fishable pools you stand and cast from, path-circulation the bank trail linking them, and collectible-nodes the fish the loop is built on. water-body is the clear creek itself, which the prompt names outright. Decided without a user: no scoring or objective was added since none was asked for, the rocks and grassy banks are dressing rather than terrain-relief so this stays flat P0, and although water-body carries CHECK the creek is shallow and cast into from the bank, never swum, so the play space is a single grounded surface and the check should clear.
